releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
Hypergamous Tree Chopping Simulator 3 - Update 1.1.6

- Increased active Lumberjack, Sawmill, and Steam Engine output and eased their escalating costs.
- First Prestige is now available after rebirth 25; later Prestiges still require rebirth 50.
- Added the global one-of-one Oblivion Case and server-rolled relic claim.
- Offline earnings remain disabled.
- Improved leaderboard retry, authentication, and direct REST fallback handling.
- Added unique generated rebirth, axe upgrade, and axe skin names, plus smoother early rebirth shard rewards.
